We have a PhD opening at our Dyson School of Design Engineering on Engaging Multi-Platform Data Collection for Digital Wellbeing.

Fully funded (UK home fees only), 3.5 years, application deadline February 26.

In this PhD, you will design, develop, and evaluate an engaging, open-source, privacy-preserving just-in-time adaptive intervention that focuses on video games and emotion regulation among adolescents. You will develop and test a system that collects behavioural data on gameplay across console, PC, and smartphone platforms, combined with smartphone-based momentary measures of affect and motivation.
